sn45.128-132:1.10: the Ganges, Yamunā, Aciravatī, Sarabhū, and Mahī, all of them slant, slope, and incline to the east;
sn45.128-132:1.11: In the same way, a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.128-132:1.12: And how does a mendicant who develops the noble eightfold path slant, slope, and incline to extinguishment?
sn45.128-132:1.13: It’s when a mendicant develops right view, which slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment … develops right concentration, which slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.128-132:1.14: That’s how a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.”
